body:

Current metadata selects127469 records paths/2190843187 logical blob bytes; the stored survey126149 rows/22984582 lines remains historical. Generated CODE totals are not a reading budget. Review records where they can mislead a current reader, with explicit line-range coverage; table the rest by folder. No deletion, relocation, historical transcript rewrite or disk-savings claim is selected.

Accepted T39 corrections remain accepted but are absent from this coordinator source snapshot; #686/#807/#346 own their actual integration. #1407 remains the separate M6 backlog for nested monthly indexes and individual review of33 references/2770 lines. Separate accepted branch records do not create a merged source tree. Root owns scope, brief, criteria, outcomes, final acceptance and ordered integration.

Can this be done on the VM? This work is immutable record/metadata analysis and new host record-check validation; no runtime behavior or removal proof is proposed. No build, guest, provider, host capacity, device or cloud action is authorized.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] #693 has a proved immutable ten-section brief, exact source/seed/worktree dispatch and current agent-verifiable criteria; kickoff futro and unfamiliar-executor corrections are retained. Evidence: v2 at647a8831739ffa28995e1955e68225ca0226c926, dispatch6603284080, kickoff6602741366/addendum6603203882 and docs/qa-logs/2026-11-03-m6-records-preparation/; executor acknowledged exact seed/branch/clean state.
- [ ] #693's named audit artifacts, finite route/range coverage, folder totals and genuine Phase7 outcomes pass the applicable record lints; root acceptance and verified completion marker retain source and historical-evidence limitations.
- [ ] Actual ordered records integration preserves historical bytes and whole ledger entries, passes new integration/record gates, and is recorded separately from simulated integration before #693 and this epic close.

#693 is the child slice. Backlog #1407 remains separately scheduled; no extra audit or cleanup is created to occupy a lane.
